triage_records.title: Exercise therapy improves aerobic capacity of inpatients with major depressive disorder
triage_records.relevance_rationale: The paper investigates the effect of aerobic exercise on aerobic capacity (cardiovascular fitness) in patients with Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), not on depressive symptoms. While it confirms the population (MDD) and intervention (aerobic exercise), the primary outcome is physiological (VO2max, VAT) rather than the clinical outcome requested (depressive symptoms). Therefore, it provides indirect evidence regarding the mechanism or a secondary benefit, but does not directly answer the question about symptom reduction.
